name: Cá trình
summary: Cá trình is its own line on the 20 June 2013 board, separate from cá song. One floating-door line prints trình biển. The board does not say trình biển is the same fish.
howToEat: Order it by weight. The cooking method is not given. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: The town boards, including Bến Bèo. A current door is Check on arrival. The 20 June 2013 board is a price list. A current price is Check on arrival.
